articles.summary: Figuring out Ohio Medicaid income limits shouldn't feel like a second job—but for many families trying to access in-home care, it does. Whether you're exploring PASSPORT, MyCare Ohio, or Structured Family Caregiving, income is often the first hurdle you'll face. This guide breaks down the 2026 income limits by category, explains when assets matter (and when they don't), and walks you through what to do if you're over the limit. Includes current income charts, eligibility pathways for long-term care support, and practical next steps for Ohio families navigating Medicaid.
articles.title: Ohio Medicaid Income Limits (2026): the numbers, the common sticking points, and what to do next

articles.summary: Trying to get Medicaid waiver support in Ohio? The first step is figuring out which system you belong to. Ohio has two separate waiver tracks: DODD waivers for people with developmental disabilities that started before age 22, and aging waivers (like PASSPORT) for older adults or people with disabilities acquired later in life. Applying to the wrong system can cost you months of time. This guide explains the key differences, who qualifies for what, and which agency to contact first.
articles.title: DODD vs Aging Waiver in Ohio: Which Program Do You Qualify For?
